title: Bipolar molecular outflow of the very low-mass star Par-Lup3-4. Evidence for scaled-down low-mass star formation
question: Characterize the bipolar molecular outflow of the very low-mass star Par-Lup3-4 and test whether VLM stars form as a scaled-down version of low-mass star formation.

what.value: Teff 3197 K, L=0.003 Lsun, accretion rate

evidence.quote: including a temperature of 3197 K and a luminosity of 0.003 L$_{\odot}$ (cite: alcalaetal14-1)
The velocity of the jet is 168 $\pm$ 30 km/s in the plane of the sky

what.value: Dust opacities for thin ice mantles at 10^6 cm^-3

evidence.quote: $\kappa_{\lambda}$ is the absorption coefficient obtained from (cite: Ose94) for thin ice mantles and a density of $10^{6}$ cm$^{-3}$.

what.value: Previous ALMA fluxes 0.91±0.26 mJy (B7) and 0.35±0.11 mJy

evidence.quote: who measured a flux of 0.35$\pm$0.11 mJy.

recipe.method: CASA CLEAN with Briggs weighting, varied robust; continuum from line-free channels; primary beam correction
Optically thin M = S D^2 / (B(Tdust) kappa), Tdust from stellar luminosity, Ossenkopf & Henning opacities
key_parameters: Tdust 15 K (R=1.1 Rsun) or 20 K (R=2 Rsun); kappa 0.85 (1.3 mm), 1.8 (0.89 mm) cm2/g
assumptions: Distance 155 pc; optically thin thermal dust

recipe.method: Lobe length, opening and position angles measured by hand on CO(3-2) 3σ contour; mass from optically thin channel-by-channel CO(3-2), Tex ~26.4 K, no inclination correction; then dynamical quantities from formulas
assumptions: Material near plane of sky (limb brightening); emission near source excluded so mass is lower limit

recipe.method: alpha from fluxes at 328 and 225 GHz with propagated error
Grid of MCFOST radiative transfer models with 8 free parameters, chi2 for two near-IR datasets
key_parameters: Teff fixed 3200 K, d 155 pc; stellar radius 1.1, 1.5, 2, 2.5 Rsun

evidence.quote: Par-Lup-3-4 was detected at a 6$\sigma$ level with a flux density of 0.31$\pm$0.05 mJy
yielding an unresolved source with a flux density of 0.59$\pm$0.06 mJy
The derived masses for the dust at a temperature of 20 K are 0.28 $\pm$ 0.05 M$\mathrm{_{\oplus}}$ for Band 7
We obtained a total outflow mass of 9.5$\times$10$^{-7}$ M$_{\odot}$
providing an angle of 108$^{\circ}$ for the southern lobe and 116$^{\circ}$ for the northern lobe.
The wind mass-loss rate derived for Par-Lup3-4 is 1.53$\times$10$^{-10}$ M$_{\odot}$ /yr
we calculated the optical depth and obtained a value of 0.31
